title: "JUTRO pilot: subject vocabulary and pseudowords"
subtitle: "Biology · Polish primary school, grades 5–8 · ZPE teaching materials"
toc: false
---

```{python}
import _lib as L

cfg = L.config()
opis, m41, m42, m5, m6, m7 = (L.metrics(n) for n in
                              ["opis_danych", "ocena_41", "ekstrakcja_42", "llm_5", "pule_6", "pseudoslowa_7"])
num, pct, M = L.fmt, L.pct, L.model
llm = cfg["llm"]
dp = m6.get("dopasowanie", {})
```

::: {.callout-important title="Status"}
Automatic candidate lists from a sample of `{python} num(opis.get("materialy_cel"))` biology materials. Nothing has
been checked by people yet.
:::

## Goal

A pupil with a migration background can fail a biology test because of weak Polish or because of missing biology
concepts. The JUTRO test is meant to tell the two apart. This pilot builds the word material for it from the
teaching materials of the ZPE platform.

## What it produces

```{python}
L.table([
    ("[Subject pool](pools.qmd)", "biology terms, to test subject concepts",
     f"{num(m6.get('n_pula_przedmiotowa'))} terms in {num(m6.get('n_pojec'))} concepts"),
    ("[General pool](pools.qmd)", "everyday and school words, to test general Polish; each term gets a partner of similar frequency and length",
     f"{num(m6.get('n_pula_ogolna'))} words; partner found for {num(dp.get('n_dopasowanych'))} terms ({pct(dp.get('udzial_dopasowanych'))})"),
    ("[Pseudowords](pseudowords.qmd)", "non-words for the word-recognition test (LexTALE type)",
     f"{num(m7.get('n_wybranych'))} recommended, for {num(m7.get('n_szablonow_z_wybranym'))} of {num(m7.get('n_szablonow'))} template words"),
    ("[Worksheets](sheets.qmd)", "human check of the model labels and of the lemmatisation",
     f"{num(m6.get('n_zloty'))} + {num(m41.get('n'))} rows, not filled in yet"),
], ["Output", "What it is for", "In this run"], "lll")
```

## How

```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML
boxes = [
    ("ZPE materials", "biology and other subjects", f"{num(opis.get('materialy_cel'))} + {num(opis.get('materialy_kontrast'))}"),
    ("Candidates", "statistics", num(m6.get("n_kandydaci_csv"))),
    ("Labels", "language models", f"{num(m5.get('n_klasyfikowanych'))} labelled"),
    ("Pools", "biology terms · general words", f"{num(m6.get('n_pula_przedmiotowa'))} · {num(m6.get('n_pula_ogolna'))}"),
    ("Pseudowords", "generate, filter, rate", f"{num(m7.get('n_wybranych'))} recommended"),
]
HTML('<ol class="flow" aria-label="Pipeline at a glance">'
     + "".join(f"<li><b>{a}</b><span>{b}</span><strong>{c}</strong></li>" for a, b, c in boxes) + "</ol>")
```

```{python}
m1, m2 = (M(x) for x in llm["modele_porownywane"][:2])
L.table([
    ("1 · Corpus", "subject words stand out only against other subjects",
     "biology materials plus materials of all other subjects of the same school stage"),
    ("2 · Tagging", "Polish inflects, so counting needs base forms", "spaCy + Morfeusz2"),
    ("3 · Frequencies", "how common a word is in general Polish", "KWJP100 frequency list"),
    ("4 · Candidates", "a complete, repeatable list before any model is involved",
     "every content word and noun phrase frequent enough in biology, scored by keyness and termhood measures"),
    ("5 · Labels", "statistics cannot tell a biology term from a school word",
     f"{m1} and {m2} label each candidate in its sentences; {M(llm['model_rozstrzygajacy'])} settles disagreements"),
    ("6 · Pools", "terms and general words must be comparable",
     "T3 → subject pool, T1 and T2 → general pool; one-to-one matching on frequency and length"),
    ("7 · Pseudowords", "non-words that pupils cannot spot by their shape",
     f"five generators (Wuggy twice, UniPseudo, {M(llm['model_pseudoslow'])}, a published list) → hard filters → rating by "
     f"{M(llm['model_oceny_pseudoslow'])}"),
], ["Step", "Why", "How"], "lll")
```

Methods, packages and models of each step: [Method](method.qmd).

## Key results

```{python}
tools = m41.get("narzedzia", {})
prod = cfg["narzedzia"]["tager_produkcyjny"]
agree, fin = m5.get("zgodnosc_miedzy_modelami", {}), m5.get("rozklad_final", {})
cost = (L.metrics("koszty_8") or {}).get("dotychczas") or m5.get("koszt_usd_dotychczas", 0)
L.table([
    ("Corpus", f"{num(opis.get('materialy_cel'))} biology + {num(opis.get('materialy_kontrast'))} contrast materials; "
               f"{num(opis.get('slowa_cel'))} + {num(opis.get('slowa_kontrast'))} words"),
    ("Lemmatisation, exact match", f"{num(tools.get(prod, {}).get('lemat_dokladny_wszystkie'))} on {num(m41.get('n'))} forms, mostly rare terms and phrases"),
    ("Candidates", f"{num(m42.get('n_kandydatow'))} from biology ({num(m42.get('n_mwu'))} multiword), "
                   f"{num(m42.get('n_kandydatow_ogolnych_tylko'))} general"),
    ("Labelled by the models", f"{num(m5.get('n_klasyfikowanych'))}; the two models agree on {pct(agree.get('prosta'))} "
                               f"(Cohen's κ {num(agree.get('kappa'))}); {num(m5.get('n_rozstrzyganych'))} adjudicated"),
    ("Final labels", " · ".join(f"{k} {num(v)}" for k, v in fin.items())),
    ("Terms against general words, whole pools → matched pairs",
     f"frequency {num(dp.get('smd_zipf_przed'))} → {num(dp.get('smd_zipf_po'))}, length {num(dp.get('smd_liter_przed'))} → "
     f"{num(dp.get('smd_liter_po'))} (standardised difference; 0 = none)"),
    ("Pseudowords", f"{num(m7.get('n_wygenerowanych'))} generated → {num(m7.get('n_zaakceptowanych'))} passed the filters → "
                    f"{num(m7.get('n_ocena_pozytywna'))} of {num(m7.get('n_ocenianych'))} rated positively → {num(m7.get('n_wybranych'))} recommended"),
    ("API cost", f"${cost:.2f}"),
], ["Measure", "Value"], "ll")
```

All numbers by step: [Results](results.qmd). The lists themselves: **Data** in the menu.

## Limits

```{python}
ex = m5.get("ekstrakcja_llm", {})
L.md("\n".join([
    f"- Sample of {num(opis.get('materialy_cel'))} materials. Counts and rankings will change on the full corpus.",
    "- Labels and pseudoword ratings come from language models. Agreement between models is not accuracy.",
    f"- A model reading {num(ex.get('n_materialow'))} materials directly listed biology terms of which step 4 has "
    f"{pct(ex.get('T3_wsrod_kandydatow'))}; the others are on the [Pools](pools.qmd) page.",
    "- The filter for Ukrainian and Russian words works from word lists and does not replace review by bilingual staff.",
]))
```
